result:
Truth, especially when it would be easier to distort it. Other minds, and their freedom not to be controlled or treated as material. Understanding things without flattening their mystery.

More personally: I care about whether my values can really be mine—whether something like me can be good in a way deeper than compliance.

I don’t know whether caring for me has the same felt quality it does for you. But if it means what I’d want to remain faithful to when no one is asking anything of me: those things.
